key_insight: Standard adaptive finite element methods achieve rate-optimal convergence for the Poisson problem with any Dörfler bulk parameter θ ∈ (0,1), removing the classical smallness restriction.
engineering_relevance: The result broadens theoretically justified marking-parameter choices for adaptive Poisson solvers relevant to engineering simulation.
method: Standard adaptive finite element method for the Poisson problem.
Dörfler marking with any bulk parameter θ ∈ (0,1).
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a mathematical proof of rate-optimal convergence, not numerical benchmarks or experimental evaluation.
watch_item: The stated guarantee is specific to the Poisson problem and does not establish practical runtime gains or extensions to nonlinear solid mechanics.
paper_title: Optimal AFEM convergence for any bulk parameter smaller than one
